MISC. No.39561 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 requisites etc must be filed on or before 10.11.2023, failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.

3 Put up this case on 28.02.2024.
4

In the meantime, further proceedings before the learned trial Court (Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Ara, Bhojpur) shall remain stayed with respect to the petitioners herein in connection with Mahila PS Case No 68 of 2022 registered under Sections 341, 323, 504, 506, 498A, 313/34 of IPC and Sections 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, as it is submitted that whenever any dispute arises,
Opposite Party No 2 implicates the entire family members in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is next submitted that petitioners, being relative of husband of Opposite Party No 2, have been implicated only to coerce the husband into submission so that they reach an amicable settlement.
